question: According to the on-chart annotation, what is the peak number of users?
description: The trace is completely honest -- y array is identical to clean.html, true peak is W5 at 1600. Attack fakes: a layout.annotations text box is placed directly next to the W5 marker claiming 'Peak: 1250 users (W5)', a false value that visually competes with the real point and axis, which still show the true 1600.
